content.comment_body: Hello, I'm developing my first project with [product_name] and I'm unsure about the input voltage details from the datasheet. The datasheet states that the digital input of [product_name] registers a SIGNAL 1 if the input is above 12VAC, but it doesn't specify the upper voltage limit. Can I use a 24VDC input as signal 1? Is it also possible to use a 127VAC input? Thank you for your assistance. [user_name]
No, 127 VAC is not allowed for the digital input of [product_name]. Allowed values are: For AC: maximum 26.4V For DC: maximum 28.8V See also the attached document.
Hi [user_name], Thanks for sharing the information and manual pages. The manual I have in Portuguese does not provide the voltage limits for digital inputs. Regards.
Hello [user_name], You're welcome. Appreciate your feedback.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for clarification regarding the voltage limits for digital inputs on [product_name], noting that datasheets and some translated manuals lack sufficient information. The absence of clearly documented voltage limits leads to confusion, underscoring the importance of straightforward technical documentation, especially for beginners.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect technical specifications for [product_name] digital input voltage limits to be clearly defined and easily accessible in datasheets and manuals.
